source.transcription_basis: User-visible codex_delegation coordination handoffs plus Git-verifiable lineage and one independent read-only source/reporting review in the audit task.

reproduction.observed_failure: Remote-Site and inactive assignees were notified on unchanged baseline source.

remediated_contract.scheduler_boundary: Lock and reload the current task, Shift, assignee and employee profile; require incomplete due work, scheduled or in-progress Shift status, canonical Shift/client/Site convergence, and current approved Site access before claiming reminder_sent_at, notifying, or signalling.
remediated_contract.ineligible_boundary: At scheduler time, ineligible recipients leave reminder_sent_at null and receive neither notification nor Facility signal.
remediated_contract.queued_delivery_boundary: Reload and revalidate current task, Shift, recipient, assignment, completion, due state and approved Site access before channel selection and before each channel exposes content. Queue-time denial suppresses delivery only; it does not clear an already-claimed marker or retract an already-emitted Facility signal.
remediated_contract.compatibility: Preserve due and overnight behavior, database claim and duplicate suppression, preferences and channels, content, valid Facility signal behavior, and exception rollback.
remediated_contract.architecture: One operating organisation across multiple Sites; current approved Site access, exact capability, canonical Shift and recipient ownership, direct-object denial, and privacy are the boundaries, not tenant isolation.

independent_review.review_scope: Independent source, test, Git-lineage, bounded-contract, and reporting-semantics review.
corrected_no_go_items: Use a fresh per-attempt Site-access service so scoped-cache object-ID reuse cannot leak authorization across a scheduler batch.
Give the existing push-preference fixture valid canonical Site and current-profile provenance without weakening production authorization.
